title: ElectionWatch Snapshot
description: Top-level snapshot published every 30 s to R2; consumed by the frontend overview page.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (with IST offset +05:30) of the last scraper write.

states.description: Keyed by ECI state code (S03, S11, S22, S25, U06).

national_alliance_view.description: Seats leading/won aggregated by alliance across all 824 constituencies.

data_source.description: Which scraper path produced this snapshot.

stale.description: True when scraper has not pushed a fresh cycle in >90 s; frontend shows stale banner.

stale_since.description: Present (non-null) only when stale=true. Timestamp when scraper last succeeded.

total_seats.description: Total assembly constituencies in this state.

leading.description: Party code → seats where party is leading or has won.

declared.description: Number of constituencies where result has been declared.

source.description: Per-state data source, may differ from top-level when using fallback.
